# Pink PvP Pack

Pink PvP Pack is a modern resource pack created for players who enjoy a clean pink aesthetic while staying focused during PvP. The pack combines simple, high-quality textures with a consistent color palette to provide a fresh look without affecting gameplay.

## Features

* Clean pink-themed textures
* Optimized for PvP
* Clear and easy-to-read visuals
* Lightweight and performance-friendly
* Vanilla-friendly style
* Regular updates and improvements

This resource pack is designed for modern Minecraft versions. Some textures may vary depending on the game version.
